intent: Allow the measured release-lint workload to finish inside a bounded process and step, retain its complete output, and preserve every validation and publication gate.

failureEvidence.annotation: The action 'Verify release compatibility and lint' has timed out after 45 minutes.
failureEvidence.limitation: The artifact has completed debug lint and earlier compilation GC reports, but no release-lint report, command log or lint GC. No OOM, lint finding or application defect is established.

comparison.limitation: Fit uses the observed main prefix and cleanup; it is not proof that a future hosted run has passed.

constraints: Keep the 175-minute job cap, default 3 GiB heap and 1 GiB metaspace, disabled configuration cache and one worker.
Keep checkReleaseAarMetadata and lintRelease, deterministic failure propagation, and every required release/signing/source/asset gate.
Use the existing single process-group deadline across eligible dependency retries; a deadline failure must not be retried automatically.
Preserve all incoming shared-branch commits. No forced ref updates, skipped checks, duplicate publication or blind reruns.
A new final-head PR and exact-main hosted qualification are still required before publication.

implementation.output: Explicit bash pipefail preserves Gradle failure through tee; the existing always-uploaded release-*.log glob captures the complete lint output.

focused.actualWatchdogBoundary: Existing gradle_retry tests exercise real stalled descendants, process-group retirement and no timeout retry.
focused.shellBoundary: Executes the exact workflow shell fragment with a controlled Gradle-command port. Proves argument wiring, retained stdout/stderr, and failure propagation. Does not execute Android lint or establish hosted runtime. Existing gradle_retry tests separately exercise actual process-group deadlines and no timeout retry.
focused.isolatedInvocationCorrection: The first CI-policy subset invocation lacked its scripts import path and produced5 import errors. The corrected invocation passed20/20 without source changes; the original log is retained.

canonicalFast.qualification: Canonical host checks and exact release scope only; full hosted Android, Windows, device and publication qualification remain pending.

integration.independentReview: CI and Gateway clear by voice_repo_review; fresh-progress guard clear by voice_design_review; immutable component hashes preserved during integration.
integration.qualification: The subsequent checkpoint-only commit records these results; final hosted checks must bind the public shared head.
